verses.text: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textZh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：

verses.text: 'Command the sons of Israel and say to them, 'You shall be careful to present My offering, My food for My offerings by fire, of a soothing aroma to Me, at their appointed time.'
verses.textZh: 你要吩咐以色列人說：獻給我的供物，就是獻給我作馨香火祭的食物，你們要按日期獻給我；

verses.text: 'You shall say to them, 'This is the offering by fire which you shall offer to the LORD: two male lambs one year old without defect [as] a continual burnt offering every day.
verses.textZh: 又要對他們說：你們要獻給耶和華的火祭，就是沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，每日兩隻，作為常獻的燔祭。

verses.text: 'You shall offer the one lamb in the morning and the other lamb you shall offer at twilight;
verses.textZh: 早晨要獻一隻，黃昏的時候要獻一隻；

verses.text: also a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a grain offering, mixed with a fourth of a hin of beaten oil.
verses.textZh: 又用細麵伊法十分之一，並搗成的油一欣四分之一，調和作為素祭。

verses.text: 'It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai as a soothing aroma, an offering by fire to the LORD.
verses.textZh: 這是西乃山所命定為常獻的燔祭，是獻給耶和華為馨香的火祭。

verses.text: 'Then the drink offering with it [shall be] a fourth of a hin for each lamb, in the holy place you shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD.
verses.textZh: 為這一隻羊羔，要同獻奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。在聖所中，你要將醇酒奉給耶和華為奠祭。

verses.text: 'The other lamb you shall offer at twilight; as the grain offering of the morning and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering by fire, a soothing aroma to the LORD.
verses.textZh: 晚上，你要獻那一隻羊羔，必照早晨的素祭和同獻的奠祭獻上，作為馨香的火祭，獻給耶和華。

verses.text: 'Then on the sabbath day two male lambs one year old without defect, and two-tenths [of an] [ephah] of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and its drink offering:
verses.textZh: 當安息日，要獻兩隻沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，並用調油的細麵伊法十分之二為素祭，又將同獻的奠祭獻上。

verses.text: '[This is] the burnt offering of every sabbath in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.textZh: 這是每安息日獻的燔祭；那常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭在外。

verses.text: 'Then at the beginning of each of your months you shall present a burnt offering to the LORD: two bulls and one ram, seven male lambs one year old without defect;
verses.textZh: 每月朔，你們要將兩隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，七隻沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，獻給耶和華為燔祭。

verses.text: and three-tenths [of an] [ephah] of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering, for each bull; and two-tenths of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering, for the one ram;
verses.textZh: 每隻公牛要用調油的細麵伊法十分之三作為素祭；那隻公羊也用調油的細麵伊法十分之二作為素祭；

verses.text: and a tenth [of an] [ephah] of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering for each lamb, for a burnt offering of a soothing aroma, an offering by fire to the LORD.
verses.textZh: 每隻羊羔要用調油的細麵伊法十分之一作為素祭和馨香的燔祭，是獻給耶和華的火祭。

verses.text: 'Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull and a third of a hin for the ram and a fourth of a hin for a lamb; this is the burnt offering of each month throughout the months of the year.
verses.textZh: 一隻公牛要奠酒半欣，一隻公羊要奠酒一欣三分之一，一隻羊羔也奠酒一欣四分之一。這是每月的燔祭，一年之中要月月如此。

verses.text: 'And one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD; it shall be offered with its drink offering in addition to the continual burnt offering.
verses.textZh: 又要將一隻公山羊為贖罪祭，獻給耶和華；要獻在常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭以外。

verses.text: 'Then on the fourteenth day of the first month shall be the LORD'S Passover.
verses.textZh: 正月十四日是耶和華的逾越節。

verses.text: 'On the fifteenth day of this month [shall be] a feast, unleavened bread [shall be] eaten for seven days.
verses.textZh: 這月十五日是節期，要吃無酵餅七日。

verses.text: 'On the first day [shall be] a holy convocation; you shall do no laborious work.
verses.textZh: 第一日當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。

verses.text: 'You shall present an offering by fire, a burnt offering to the LORD: two bulls and one ram and seven male lambs one year old, having them without defect.
verses.textZh: 當將公牛犢兩隻，公綿羊一隻，一歲的公羊羔七隻，都要沒有殘疾的，用火獻給耶和華為燔祭。

verses.text: 'For their grain offering, you shall offer fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths [of an] [ephah] for a bull and two-tenths for the ram.
verses.textZh: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵；為一隻公牛要獻伊法十分之三；為一隻公羊要獻伊法十分之二；

verses.text: 'A tenth [of an] [ephah] you shall offer for each of the seven lambs;
verses.textZh: 為那七隻羊羔，每隻要獻伊法十分之一。

verses.text: and one male goat for a sin offering to make atonement for you.
verses.textZh: 並獻一隻公山羊作贖罪祭，為你們贖罪。

verses.text: 'You shall present these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
verses.textZh: 你們獻這些，要在早晨常獻的燔祭以外。

verses.text: 'After this manner you shall present daily, for seven days, the food of the offering by fire, of a soothing aroma to the LORD; it shall be presented with its drink offering in addition to the continual burnt offering.
verses.textZh: 一連七日，每日要照這例把馨香火祭的食物獻給耶和華，是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭以外。

verses.text: 'On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no laborious work.
verses.textZh: 第七日當有聖會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。

verses.text: 'Also on the day of the first fruits, when you present a new grain offering to the LORD in your [Feast of] Weeks, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no laborious work.
verses.textZh: 七七節莊稼初熟，你們獻新素祭給耶和華的日子，當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。

verses.text: 'You shall offer a burnt offering for a soothing aroma to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs one year old;
verses.textZh: 只要將公牛犢兩隻，公綿羊一隻，一歲的公羊羔七隻，作為馨香的燔祭獻給耶和華。

verses.text: and their grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths [of an] [ephah] for each bull, two-tenths for the one ram,
verses.textZh: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵；為每隻公牛要獻伊法十分之三；為一隻公羊要獻伊法十分之二；

verses.text: a tenth for each of the seven lambs;
verses.textZh: 為那七隻羊羔，每隻要獻伊法十分之一。

verses.text: [also] one male goat to make atonement for you.
verses.textZh: 並獻一隻公山羊為你們贖罪。

verses.text: 'Besides the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, you shall present [them] with their drink offerings. They shall be without defect.
verses.textZh: 這些，你們要獻在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外，都要沒有殘疾的。
